highlights.title: Transit-map look
highlights.text: The Light and Dark themes are restyled as a transit map, and the commit graph draws stations as rings with filled dots for merges.

fixes: The diff toolbar hides the file counter when only one file is shown.
Long lists in the graph, History files and diff are virtualized for smoother scrolling.

highlights.title: List or tree for changed files
highlights.text: Press V in a file list, or use the button in its header, to group changed files by folder in Changes and in a commit's files in History. Selecting a folder in Changes selects every file in it.

fixes: The commit message box clears a pre-filled merge message when the merge ends without using Oak's Commit button.
History no longer flashes a flat file list before the tree appears when stepping between commits.
